scripts.//test: Contract check for the mock backend. Plain node, no runner — see tests/.
scripts.//tauri:dev: Hot-reloading app against the real backend. Runs from the crate root (that is where tauri.conf.json lives). --no-default-features turns off `custom-protocol` — a default here so plain cargo builds work — which is what lets the webview use this dev server instead of the embedded dist/.
